target_customer: Hedge funds, prop trading firms, sports funds, OTC desks and family offices trading prediction markets
problem: Professional traders on Kalshi, Polymarket and similar venues lack consolidated execution, positions, financing and reporting across exchanges.
business_model: Prime brokerage and execution platform with terminal and API; fees and financing, details not public
product_category: Fintech infrastructure, prediction market prime brokerage

founders.name: Antonin Parrot
founders.background_notes: Surname spelled Perrot in some press. Education not found.

competitors.name: Stand
competitors.what: Trading terminal across Polymarket and Kalshi

competitors.name: Interactive Brokers
competitors.what: Unified prediction market interface over Kalshi, CME and ForecastEx

competitors.name: Paradigm
competitors.what: Professional terminal above exchanges, building in 2026

technical_complexity.rationale: Smart order routing and normalized APIs across venues is standard trading infrastructure with hard parts in latency, risk and compliance.

defensibility.rationale: Positions, financing and a planned CFTC FCM affiliate registration lock in institutions, but big brokers and Kalshi's own terminal compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Within months incumbents launched unified interfaces and prime brokerage access to Kalshi.

market_need_then: Prediction market volume exploded in 2025 and 2026 and institutions needed professional execution beyond consumer interfaces.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, operator focused: 'Spend your time on alpha, not infra.'

branding.community_and_virality: Fortune and crypto trade press covered the seed round; no mascot or community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Press covers the company but not the brand; a branding search found no brand specific coverage.

outcome_analysis: River Markets is an early company that raised an $8.5M seed led by Haun Ventures within months of its Spring 2026 YC batch, on rapid reported volume growth and quant founders from BlackRock and HFT. Incumbent brokers and Kalshi moved into the same layer, so the outcome depends on winning institutions before them.
notes: Close date reported as July in one outlet and announced August 9 on the company blog. Valuation undisclosed. HQ listed as San Francisco (YC) and New York (some press). Founding year not found. Traction claims ($50M+ traded, 200% weekly growth) are company stated.
